ui-palette-chroma.$description: Chroma of the palette source color, as a multiplier of `0.21`.

ui-palette-hue.$description: Hue of the palette source color in degrees. Green in light mode and blue in dark mode by default.

ui-palette-hue-rotate-by.$description: Hue drift per palette step in degrees: each step rotates one more time than the last, so `1` spreads 15° across the ramp. The severity scopes use `1` for livelier tints, the brand palette `0`.

ui-palette-source.$description: The source color the palette is derived from. Set it to replace `--ui-palette-hue` and `--ui-palette-chroma`. Any color works: the palette keeps its oklch hue, scales its chroma and sets the lightness per step. See [Palette](/guide/theming#palette).

ui-gray-chroma.$description: Chroma of the gray ramp. Raise it for tinted grays.

ui-palette-accent.$description: The accent shade of the current palette: `Callout` icons and outlined borders, the `abbr` underline. Stronger with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope, so `.ui-success` gets a green one.

ui-palette-border.$description: The border shade of the current palette: tonal `Callout` borders. Stronger with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-strong.$description: The strongest shade of the current palette, the darkest in light mode and the lightest in dark mode, with the most contrast against the page: `Callout` text, the default `Button` fill when `--ui-button-accent` is unset, the text of a warning `Badge`. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-text.$description: A readable text shade of the current palette: `del`, `ins`, `.ui-del` and `.ui-ins`. Darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-tint.$description: The tonal fill of the current palette: primary and critical tonal buttons when `--ui-primary-tonal` is unset. Stronger with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-tint-subtle.$description: A faint fill of the current palette: tonal severity `Callout`s. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
ui-palette-tint-subtle.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-color-3) l c h / 60%), oklch(from var(--ui-color-6) l c h / 5%) )

ui-blue.$description: A literal blue, Open Props' `--hue-blue` at the palette lightness. No severity meaning.

ui-green.$description: A literal green, Open Props' `--hue-green` at the palette lightness. No severity meaning.

ui-orange.$description: A literal orange, Open Props' `--hue-orange` at the palette lightness. No severity meaning.

ui-red.$description: A literal red, Open Props' `--hue-red` at the palette lightness. No severity meaning.

ui-critical.$description: Severity color for errors and destructive actions.

ui-invalid.$description: Color for invalid field borders, fills and outlines.

ui-invalid-text.$description: Color for validation messages and invalid labels. Lighter than `--ui-invalid` in dark mode so the text stays readable.
ui-invalid-text.$value: light-dark( var(--ui-invalid), oklch(from var(--ui-invalid) max(l, 0.75) c h) )

ui-primary.$description: Brand color for primary actions and accents.

ui-on-primary.$description: Text color on `--ui-primary`. Derived with relative color: near-black when the primary's lightness is above 0.565, near-white below, tinted with 15% of its chroma, so a custom `--ui-primary` gets readable text.
ui-on-primary.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-primary) clamp(0.15, (0.565 - l) * 1000, 0.98) calc(c * 0.15) h )

ui-primary-text.$description: Primary as a text color: links, and `Button` with `.ui-primary` and no variant or `.ui-outlined`. When unset, each derives a readable shade from `--ui-primary`. Set it when the primary is too light or too dark for text.

ui-primary-tonal.$description: Background of `Button` and `ButtonGroup` with `.ui-primary` and `.ui-tonal`. When unset, a light tint of the palette. Material's `primary-container` and shadcn's `secondary` go here.

ui-on-primary-tonal.$description: Text color on `--ui-primary-tonal`. Set it with `--ui-primary-tonal`.

ui-text-disabled.$description: Text color of disabled buttons and chips.

ui-on-inverse-muted.$description: Muted text color on an inverted surface.

ui-on-accent.$description: Near-white text on a saturated fill in both modes: critical buttons, severity `Badge`s and the checked choice mark in dark mode.

ui-text-strong.$description: Strongest text color, for headings, labels and values. Body text is `--ui-text-muted`.

ui-surface-elevated.$description: Background of elevated cards and accordions, dialogs, drawers, menus and native `Select` options.

ui-surface-filled.$description: Background of filled areas such as progress tracks and table stripes.

ui-surface-inverse.$description: Background of `Tooltip`, inverted against the page.

ui-track-color.$description: The empty part of a track: the unchecked `Switch`, `Progress` and the `Range` track. When unset, `Progress` and tonal ranges use `--ui-surface-tonal`, the default range its field border and the switch a fixed gray.

ui-radius.$description: Corner radius for every component: cards, callouts, menus, buttons and fields follow it, and small parts like `kbd`, tooltips and checkboxes never get rounder than it. Set it to `0` for square corners. Takes a single length.

ui-border-width.$description: Default border width for components that draw a border.

ui-border-width-thick.$description: Width of emphasized rules: the `Table` head and foot borders, the `AvatarGroup` ring, the `Badge` border, the neutral `Chip` dot, the dotted `DescriptionList` rule, the `Tabs` indicator, and at one and a half times, the blockquote bar.

ui-radius-round.$description: The pill radius for round buttons, avatars, badges, chips, radios, switches, the range track and the carousel buttons and markers.

ui-radius-small.$description: Corner radius of small parts: `kbd`, inline `code`, `mark`, `var`, `Tooltip`, the file input and a square `Avatar` image. `--ui-radius`, capped at 5px.

ui-radius-x-small.$description: Corner radius of the `Checkbox` box. `--ui-radius`, capped at 2px.

ui-border-color.$description: Default border color for cards, lists, tables and dividers.

ui-border-color-on-filled.$description: Border color inside filled surfaces: lists without a variant and table headers.

ui-border-color-on-raised.$description: Border color inside raised surfaces: tonal and elevated `Card` and `Accordion`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Menu` and `Callout` without a severity. Defaults to `--ui-border-color` in light mode and the page background in dark mode.

ui-control-border-color.$description: Border color of controls without a fill: `Button` with `.ui-outlined`, the edge and dividers of an outlined `ButtonGroup`, `ToggleButton`, `ToggleGroup`, `Chip` with `.ui-outlined`, the track of `Tabs` with `.ui-outlined`, and the selected `Tabs` pill. When unset, outlined buttons use their color, the selected `Tabs` pill `--ui-field-border-color` and the rest `--ui-border-color`. Themes that outline controls like fields set it to `--ui-field-border-color`.

ui-control-border-color-filled.$description: Border color of controls with a fill: `Button` with `.ui-filled` or `.ui-tonal`, the edge and dividers of a `ButtonGroup` with one of them, a checked `ToggleButton`, `Chip` without `.ui-outlined` and the `Carousel` buttons. When unset, buttons have no visible border, the carousel buttons use a shade of their fill and the rest use `--ui-border-color`. Set it with `--ui-control-border-color` to outline every control.

ui-surface-border-color.$description: Border color of tonal and elevated `Card` and `Accordion` and of `Callout` without a severity. When unset, cards and accordions use the page background color, so they stay visible on tonal surfaces, and callouts their tonal background.

ui-field-radius.$description: Corner radius for fields. When unset, they follow `--ui-radius`, also where it's set on a part of the page.

ui-field-helper-color.$description: Text color for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-helper-font-size.$description: Font size for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-helper-line-height.$description: Line height for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-label-font-weight.$description: Font weight for emphasized field labels and legends.

ui-field-border-color.$description: Border color of every empty control: `TextField`, `Select`, `Textarea`, the unchecked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`, the `Range` track and the `Progress` outline. A 50% mix of the text color into the page, so it reaches 3:1. Lighter than `--ui-border-color`, which is decorative, is a choice a theme can make.

ui-field-border-color-on-raised.$description: Field border color inside raised surfaces. Defaults to `--ui-field-border-color` in light mode and the page background in dark mode.

ui-focus-ring-color.$description: Color of the keyboard focus ring. By default the page background color inverted.
ui-focus-ring-color.$value: rgb( from var(--ui-surface-default) calc(255 - r) calc(255 - g) calc(255 - b) )

ui-focus-ring-inset.$description: Negative offset for focus rings drawn inside a control, such as `ButtonGroup`, `List` items and `Select` options.

ui-focus-ring-offset.$description: Distance between a control and its focus ring.

ui-focus-ring-style.$description: Outline style of the focus ring.

ui-font-body.$description: Font family for body text, fields and buttons. Defaults to Open Props `--font-sans`.

ui-font-code.$description: Font family for `code`, `kbd`, `samp` and `pre` in rich text, `.ui-kbd`, `.ui-samp`, `.ui-var`, code blocks and `kbd` in buttons and lists. Defaults to Open Props `--font-mono`.

ui-font-heading.$description: Font family for `h1`–`h6` and the `.ui-h1`–`.ui-h6` classes. When unset, headings follow `--ui-font-body`.

ui-font-size-100.$description: The smallest step of the type scale, 12px. `--ui-font-size-caption` reads it. Set the steps to reshape every size at once, or a role to move one.

ui-font-size-300.$description: Type scale step, 16px. `--ui-font-size-body`, `--ui-font-size-control` and `--ui-font-size-h6` read it.

ui-font-size-400.$description: Type scale step, 17.6px. `--ui-font-size-h5` reads it, and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows from it.

ui-font-size-500.$description: Type scale step, 20px. `--ui-font-size-large` reads it, `--ui-font-size-h3` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows to it.

ui-font-size-600.$description: Type scale step, 24px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h3` grows to it.

ui-font-size-700.$description: Type scale step, 32px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows from it.

ui-font-size-800.$description: Type scale step, 40px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows to it.

ui-font-size-900.$description: The largest step of the type scale, 56px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows to it.

ui-font-size-caption.$description: Font size of captions, `Badge`, `Chip`, `Divider` labels, `List` secondary text, `Menu` shortcuts, overlines, `small`, `figcaption` and x-small buttons, toggles and fields. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-100`.

ui-font-size-small.$description: Font size of helper text, `Callout`, `Table`, `Tooltip`, code blocks, dense `List` text and small buttons, chips, toggles and fields. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-200`.

ui-font-size-body.$description: Font size of body copy, `Card` text and the `Callout` title. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-font-size-control.$description: Font size of the default `Button`, `Select`, `Tabs`, `TextField`, `Textarea` and `ToggleButton`. Small and x-small sizes read `--ui-font-size-small` and `--ui-font-size-caption`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-font-size-large.$description: Font size of lead paragraphs, `.ui-p.ui-large`, the `Drawer` title and large `Avatar` initials. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-500`.

ui-font-size-h1.$description: Font size for `h1` and `.ui-h1`. Fluid between `--ui-font-size-700` and `--ui-font-size-900`.

ui-font-size-h2.$description: Font size for `h2` and `.ui-h2`. Fluid between `--ui-font-size-600` and `--ui-font-size-800`.

ui-font-size-h3.$description: Font size for `h3` and `.ui-h3`. Fluid between `--ui-font-size-500` and `--ui-font-size-600`.

ui-font-size-h4.$description: Font size for `h4` and `.ui-h4`. Fluid between `--ui-font-size-400` and `--ui-font-size-500`.

ui-font-size-h5.$description: Font size for `h5` and `.ui-h5`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-400`.

ui-font-size-h6.$description: Font size for `h6` and `.ui-h6`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-font-weight-normal.$description: Font weight for body text, `List` text and `Button` keyboard shortcuts.

ui-font-weight-medium.$description: Font weight for badges, overlines and group labels.

ui-font-weight-semibold.$description: Font weight for labels, table headers and titles.

ui-font-weight-bold.$description: Font weight for headings, buttons and terms.

ui-letter-spacing-caps.$description: Letter spacing of uppercase text: overlines and the first paragraph of an `hgroup`.

ui-letter-spacing-display.$description: Letter spacing of `h1` and `h2`, tighter than the body.

ui-letter-spacing-heading.$description: Letter spacing of `h3` and `h4`, slightly tighter than the body.

ui-line-height-tight.$description: Line height of single-line controls and compact text: field inputs, `Table` cells, `Tooltip`, `Card` captions and keyboard hints in buttons.

ui-line-height.$description: Line height of interface text: labels, helpers, choice labels and field hints.

ui-line-height-body.$description: Line height of body copy: prose, captions and `List` text.

ui-rhythm-step.$description: Vertical rhythm unit. Rich text margins and heading line heights round to it.

ui-code-block-bg-color.$description: Background of `pre.ui-code-block` and `pre` in rich text. A dark shade of the palette in both modes.

ui-code-block-text-color.$description: Text color of `pre.ui-code-block` and `pre` in rich text.

ui-space-scale.$description: Multiplier for the `--space-*` scale, the gaps, padding and margins of containers such as cards, dialogs, forms, tables and rich text. Controls follow `--ui-density` instead. See [Spacing](/guide/theming#spacing).

ui-density.$description: Multiplier for the `--ui-control-size*` scale. `0.875` is compact, `1.125` is comfortable. See [Density](/guide/theming#density).

ui-control-size-x-small.$description: Shared x-small height for fields and buttons.

ui-control-size-small.$description: Shared small height for fields and buttons.

ui-control-size.$description: Shared default height for fields and buttons so they line up.

ui-control-size-large.$description: Shared large height for fields and buttons.

ui-button-accent.$description: Color of `Button` and `ButtonGroup` without `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical`: the fill of filled buttons, the text and border of outlined and text buttons. When unset, the darkest palette color in light mode and the lightest in dark mode.

ui-button-on-accent.$description: Text color on a filled `--ui-button-accent` button. Set it with `--ui-button-accent`.

ui-button-radius.$description: Corner radius for `Button`, `ButtonGroup`, `ToggleButton` and `ToggleGroup`. When unset, they follow `--ui-radius`, also where it's set on a part of the page.

ui-button-font-weight.$description: Font weight of `Button`. When unset, buttons follow `--ui-font-weight-bold`.

ui-button-hover-shadow.$description: Shadow of `Button` with `.ui-filled`, `.ui-outlined` or `.ui-tonal` on hover. When unset, it keeps `--ui-shadow-control`.

ui-button-hover-translate.$description: Moves `Button` with `.ui-filled`, `.ui-outlined` or `.ui-tonal` on hover, as a `translate` value. Pair it with `--ui-button-hover-shadow` to press buttons into their shadow. `none` when unset.

ui-divider-space.$description: Block margin around a `Divider`, times `--ui-space-scale`. Cards, callouts, dialogs and drawers set it to `--ui-space-3`. A divider that is a direct child of a card has no margin, since the card's gap already spaces it.

ui-duration-fast.$description: Transition duration for hover and press feedback.

ui-duration-slow.$description: Transition duration for entering and leaving overlays.

ui-ease-enter.$description: Easing for elements entering the screen.

ui-ease-exit.$description: Easing for elements leaving the screen.

ui-motion.$description: Motion multiplier. `0` disables transitions, `1` is normal speed. Set to `0` automatically under `prefers-reduced-motion`. See [Motion](/guide/theming#motion).

ui-contrast.$description: `more` raises text, border, primary and focus ring contrast through a style query. Set to `more` automatically under `prefers-contrast: more`. See [Contrast](/guide/theming#contrast).

ui-choice-ripple-color.$description: Halo color for the `Checkbox` and `Radio` hover effect.

ui-selected.$description: Background of a selected control: a checked `ToggleButton`, the selected `ToggleGroup` item, and a selected or current `List` item and `Select` option. When unset, `--ui-primary` on toggles and `--ui-primary` at `--ui-state-active-alpha-accent` on list items and options. Pair it with `--ui-on-selected`.

ui-on-selected.$description: Text color on `--ui-selected`. When unset, `--ui-on-primary` on toggles, the item's own text color on list items and `--ui-primary` on a selected `Select` option.

ui-state-active-alpha.$description: Alpha of the pressed state layer on neutral buttons in light mode.

ui-state-active-alpha-accent.$description: Alpha of the pressed state layer on primary and critical buttons.

ui-state-active-alpha-dark.$description: Alpha of the pressed state layer on neutral buttons in dark mode.

ui-state-hover-alpha.$description: Alpha of the hover state layer on neutral buttons in light mode.

ui-state-hover-alpha-accent.$description: Alpha of the hover state layer on primary and critical buttons.

ui-state-hover-alpha-dark.$description: Alpha of the hover state layer on neutral buttons in dark mode.

ui-icon-size-small.$description: Icon size inside `Chip`, x-small `Avatar` and dense `List` rows, and the `Select` and autosuggest chevron.

ui-choice-accent.$description: Fill of a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`, and the thumb and fill of `Range`. When unset, `--ui-primary`, with its lightness capped in dark mode for the choice controls. Set it to `--ui-primary` for the plain primary, like Material and shadcn.

ui-choice-on-accent.$description: Color of the mark on a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`. Set it with `--ui-choice-accent`. When unset, `--ui-on-primary` in light mode and near-white in dark mode.

ui-choice-label-offset.$description: Moves `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` labels down (positive) or up (negative) against their control. Use `em` or `cap` to scale with the label font.

ui-choice-size-small.$description: `Checkbox` and `Radio` input size with `.ui-small` and inside `List`.

ui-switch-thumb-size-small.$description: Diameter of the `Switch` thumb with `.ui-small` and inside `List`.

ui-switch-track-height-small.$description: Height of the `Switch` track with `.ui-small` and inside `List`.

ui-switch-track-width-small.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-small` and inside `List`.

ui-switch-thumb-color.$description: Color of the unchecked `Switch` thumb. The checked thumb uses `--ui-choice-on-accent`.

ui-switch-track-color.$description: Background of the unchecked `Switch` track when `--ui-track-color` is unset.

ui-shadow-control.$description: Shadow of buttons with a variant and of fields. `none` by default, for themes that lift controls off the page.

ui-shadow-field.$description: Shadow of `TextField`, `Textarea` and `Select` fields. When unset, they follow `--ui-shadow-control`. Set it to `none` to lift buttons but keep fields flat.

ui-shadow-overlay.$description: Shadow of layers that float above the page: `Menu`, `Select` pickers and `Drawer`.

ui-shadow-elevated.$description: Shadow of elevated `Card` and `Accordion`. Switches between `--ui-shadow-elevated-light` and `--ui-shadow-elevated-dark` with the color scheme, also in `.ui-light` and `.ui-dark` parts of the page. Set those two instead of this one.

ui-shadow-scroll.$description: Shadow under the header and above the footer of a scrolled `Dialog` or `Drawer`, and under a sticky `Table` header. Defaults to Open Props `--shadow-4`.

ui-shadow-surface.$description: Shadow of tonal and outlined `Card` and `Accordion`, and of `Callout`. `none` by default, for themes that put every surface on the same plane.

ui-shadow-tab.$description: Shadow of the selected tab in default and `.ui-filled` `Tabs`. `.ui-line` and `.ui-outlined` have none. Defaults to Open Props `--shadow-1`.

ui-backdrop-blur.$description: Blur radius behind an open `Dialog` or `Drawer`.

ui-backdrop-color.$description: Overlay color behind an open `Dialog` or `Drawer`.
